purpose: Run the already-frozen 64-game target audit through an independently administered human commit-reveal workflow without altering terminal R1-v1 evidence.

parentEvidence.reuseRule: R1-v2 reuses the frozen sample and exact official-gamebook hashes. It never edits, resumes, or reclassifies R1-v1.

rules: All four roles must be occupied by distinct natural persons bound by distinct salted person-commitment hashes.
The identity coordinator verifies role uniqueness and natural-person attestations but performs no review, adjudication, target extraction, or gate computation.

Reviewer A and Reviewer B independently review all 64 assigned official gamebooks and cannot inspect comparison labels, the other reviewer's entries, discrepancies, or adjudication before both entry commitments are frozen.
The adjudicator is neither reviewer nor the identity coordinator and receives only anonymized disagreement rows after both reviewer reveals have verified against their frozen commitments.
An automated agent may verify hashes, schemas, completeness, state transitions, and arithmetic. It cannot occupy or attest a human role.
roles.publicArtifactRule: Public artifacts contain pseudonyms and one-way commitments only. The coordinator retains the private identity-to-role ledger outside this repository.

sourceAndBlinding.truthSource: Only the 64 exact official NFL gamebook PDF objects bound by the frozen source-capture ledger.
reviewBundleIncludes: blank target fields and frozen definitions
sourceAndBlinding.comparisonRevealRule: Existing source/model labels may be supplied to the workflow only after the complete official-truth artifact and its hash manifest are frozen. The export must bind the preregistered frozen source-index SHA-256 and use a separately verified deterministic exporter.

commitReveal.entryCommitment: Each reviewer commits SHA-256(entry bytes) plus a reviewer-controlled 256-bit salt commitment before either entry may be revealed.
commitReveal.jointFreeze: Both immutable entry commitments are registered in one hash manifest before either entry file is accepted for reveal.
commitReveal.reveal: Both revealed byte streams must exactly match their preregistered SHA-256 values and must pass the complete 64-row schema and source-hash checks.
commitReveal.mutationRule: Any changed committed byte stream, replaced commitment, duplicate game, incomplete field, wrong source hash, or post-freeze mutation terminates R1-v2 as protocol_invalid.
commitReveal.earlyRevealRule: Any attempted reveal before the joint commitment manifest exists terminates R1-v2 as protocol_invalid.

adjudication.trigger: Every reviewer disagreement or explicit AMBIGUOUS value.
adjudication.inputRule: The adjudicator receives game, field, both anonymized values, exact official-gamebook hash, and no comparison/model label.
adjudication.unresolvedRule: If the gamebook cannot resolve a target under the frozen definition, record official_truth_unresolved; do not drop, replace, or impute it.

thresholds.decisionRule: Only complete evidence satisfying every frozen review-process and target threshold may produce pass and r2Authorized=true. Any protocol violation produces terminal protocol_invalid. A valid completed audit missing a threshold produces reject_all.

failClosed: role evidence asserting a non-natural-person participant
reviewer or adjudicator acting as identity coordinator
comparison-label access before official truth is frozen
stateRules.authorizationRule: r2Authorized remains false at every nonterminal stage and for reject_all or protocol_invalid. It may become true atomically only with a verified terminal pass.
